top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a mature, independently confirmed achievement: the physiology of GLP-1 and its active form (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov), which established incretin-based treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity and is backed by large outcome trials showing glycaemic, cardiovascular and renal benefit. The three-person allocation matches the physiological discovery the citation describes, so awarding it is clearly preferable to no award.
